title: Time Value of Money (TVM) - solving more complex TVM problems (for the CFA Level 1 exam)
description:
Time Value of Money (TVM) - solving more complex TVM problems (for the CFA Level 1 exam) explores two approaches to using the Texas Instruments BA II Plus calculator to deal with more complicated exam questions.

For a comprehensive directory of all videos featured on this channel, please visit the channel companion website: www.letmeexplain.eu
